# Module registry

The Azure Container Registry every other component is published to. It has to exist before anything can be published, so it references nothing from it: an admin deploys it once, from source.

<!-- Generated by scripts/update-readme.sh from the compiled template. Edit the @description and @metadata decorators instead. -->

| | |
|---|---|
| Version | `1.0.0` |
| Use it | deployed once from source: `scripts/deploy-stack.sh 00-init-010-module-registry/<env> deploy` |
| Deploys at | subscription scope |

## Parameters

| Parameter | Required | Type |
|---|---|---|
| [pRegistryName](#pregistryname) | yes | string |
| [pResourceGroupName](#presourcegroupname) | yes | string |
| [pLocation](#plocation) | yes | string |
| [pTags](#ptags) | no | object |
| [pDeployerPrincipalId](#pdeployerprincipalid) | yes | string |
| [pPreviewerPrincipalId](#ppreviewerprincipalid) | yes | string |

### pRegistryName

Name of the registry: globally unique, letters and digits. The same name goes into bicepconfig.json.

- Type: string
- Minimum length: 5
- Maximum length: 50
- Example: `crplatformprodszn001`

### pResourceGroupName

Name of the resource group for the registry.

- Type: string
- Example: `rg-registry-prod-szn-001`

### pLocation

Azure region of the registry.

- Type: string
- Example: `switzerlandnorth`

### pTags

Tags added to every resource.

- Type: object
- Default: `{}`

### pDeployerPrincipalId

Object ID of the identity that publishes modules (AcrPush).

- Type: string

### pPreviewerPrincipalId

Object ID of the identity that previews deployments and restores modules (AcrPull).

- Type: string

## Outputs

| Output | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| oLoginServer | string | Login server of the registry, for the moduleAliases in bicepconfig.json. |
